product_overview: LibraLink is a web-based library management system that supports secure admin operations and provides tools for managing users and system-wide settings. It is designed to streamline administrative oversight through authenticated dashboards and management screens.
core_goals: View an administrative overview of system activity and status
Create, update, and remove system users
Adjust global system settings through an authenticated admin interface

features.name: Admin Dashboard
features.description: Provides administrators with a high-level overview of the system.

features.name: Manage Users
features.description: Allows administrators to create, edit, view, and delete system users.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/users.php -> View users list -> Fill in create user form -> Submit create user form -> See the new user in the list
Navigate to /admin/users.php -> View users list -> Select a user to edit -> Update user details -> Submit changes -> See updated user information in the list
Navigate to /admin/users.php -> View users list -> Select a user to delete -> Confirm deletion -> See the user removed from the list

features.name: System Settings
features.description: Allows administrators to update global application settings.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/settings.php -> Change setting values -> Save settings -> See updated settings reflected on the page
